title: Single agent with all-messages memory and tools

turns.question: Hi, I need help with my order ORD-1001. It has not arrived yet.
Can you remind me which order we are talking about?
If I order 12 more jackets at 7 euros each plus 3 euros shipping, what is the total?
turns.note: Agent calls the calculator tool; tool messages land in the node record

turns.question: Thanks. Please summarise our conversation so far.

reply.content: I am sorry about the delay. Order ORD-1001 left our warehouse on Monday and is now with the carrier.
We are talking about order ORD-1001, which is currently with the carrier.
Summary: you asked about the delayed order ORD-1001 and about a quote for 12 jackets, which comes to 87 euros.
Goodbye, and thank you for shopping with Northwind Outfitters.

expectedAfter.F13: The token holds history and flow state only: no node records, no SYSPROMPT_SENTINEL_S01_agent, and its size grows only with the messages.
